claim_boundary: Synthetic mechanism result within the Pineland model class. Not claimed as an empirical law of real-world insurgencies.
central_question: Can a prospective dimensionless capital-runway coordinate, derived from Pineland's exact stock-flow laws, predict capital-exhaustion collapse across unseen organizational mechanisms without refitting?
central_answer: Yes, with partial transport. The prospective dimensionless runway coordinate Omega_K = tau_K / T_rem (measured strictly in [60, 120] days) successfully transports zero-refit across held-out capital replenishment (H1), external resources (H2), and logistics supply burdens (H3) with pooled ROC AUC = 0.8583 and pooled Brier score = 0.1498 (vs 0.2463 base rate). Crucially, under held-out logistics burden shifts (H3), the crude parameter proxy Pi_M collapses to chance (AUC = 0.5741, Brier = 0.3456, worse than base rate), whereas Omega_K achieves exceptional zero-refit discrimination (AUC = 0.9794, Brier = 0.0634). However, the strict Strong Transport gate is not fully met because calibration slope flattens to 0.44 out-of-distribution, H2 discrimination dipped to 0.7756, and H4-H5 were stopped early by user request.

audited_capital_ledger.outflow_mechanism: Recruitment supply conversion: delta_fighters * formation_supply_days * initial_supply_fraction
inflow_mechanisms: Local fiscal extraction: sum(economic_output * 0.00015 * insurgent_control * dt/30)

frozen_law.feature_transform: log_omega = if is_inf(Omega_K) or Omega_K >= 20000.0 { 10.0 } else { min(max(ln(Omega_K), -9.21), 10.0) }

H1_replenishment.mechanism_tested: Endogenous recurring capital replenishment (local extraction scaled 0.5x to 2.0x)

H2_external_resource.mechanism_tested: Exogenous external capital subsidy (external support 0.0 vs 30,000.0/yr)

H3_logistics_cost.mechanism_tested: Logistics equipment cost per recruit (formation_supply_days 15d vs 45d -> 3-fold conversion burden shift)

pi_m_baseline.notes: Pi_M collapses to chance and performs worse than the empirical base rate because static configuration multipliers cannot sense logistics stock-flow changes.

H4_force_structure.notes: H4 force-structure simulation was stopped prior to execution.

H5_history_shock.notes: H5 history-shock simulation was stopped prior to execution.

gate_3_calibration_slope_in_range.diagnosis: Slope flattened out-of-distribution across mechanism shifts.

gate_4_monotone_direction_all.notes: Monotone direction held strictly across H1, H2, and H3.

gate_5_min_families_auc_80.diagnosis: 2 of 3 completed families met AUC >= 0.80 (H1=0.8245, H3=0.9794); H2 achieved 0.7756.

falsification_verdict.supported_boundary: The state-flow runway coordinate Omega_K demonstrates substantial transportability across unseen stock-flow mechanisms (outperforming crude parameter multipliers by ~0.09 pooled AUC and ~0.07 Brier score), but fails full Strong Synthetic Transport due to calibration compression (slope 0.44).
